digest.component_or_area: bug close workflow and ticket state persistence
propositions: Bug close currently validates then discards free-text --reason, never persisting it to reduced ticket state

A new required --class parameter accepting a bounded enum (regression, plan_defect, env_integration, flaky, preexisting, not_a_bug, duplicate, escalated, undetermined) must replace the discarded reason
The close_class value must be folded into reduced ticket state via _fold_close_class so it survives and is queryable by rebar show
Closing a bug without --class must exit nonzero and display at least one allowed enum value in stderr; invalid enum values must be rejected
The validation guard exists in two sites (txn.py transition_core and transition_close.py _completion_precheck) and both must be updated to accept the enum
